texts.li: [land:desert] Before the heat came up, {A_nameDef} found {X_indefinite} licking the dew off the stones by the well, and stood still until it had finished.
[land:tundra|land:boreal] In the blue dark before sunrise, {X_indefinite} pawed through the crust of the snow to the grass beneath. {A_nameDef} could hear every scrape from the doorway.
[land:swamp] Mist lay thick on the marsh at dawn, and {X_indefinite} stood in it up to the belly, grazing the water weed, while {A_nameDef} watched from the boardwalk.
[land:coast] First light, and {X_indefinite} picking along the top of the beach where the dune grass starts. {A_nameDef} stayed on the path until the sun was up.
[land:desert] A herd went by on the far side of the dry wash, {X_definite} at the back, and the dust hung in the air long after. {A_nameDef} could still taste it at supper.

[land:tundra|land:boreal] The herd came across the white plain in a long dark line, {X_indefinite} among them, heading for wherever the snow is thinner. {A_nameDef} watched them until they were specks.

[land:grassland] The grass was taller than {A_nameDef}'s waist, and the herd moved through it like a boat through water, {X_definite} trailing the rest. The track they left was still there days later.
[land:jungle] A hundred kinds of bird, shouting over each other in the canopy. {A_nameDef} worked under it all morning, with {X_indefinite} rooting in the leaf litter nearby.
[land:swamp] The reeds were full of birds singing over the water. {A_nameDef} ate lunch on the dike and watched {X_indefinite} paddle through the shallows below.
[land:coast] Gulls wheeled and screamed over the shore. {A_nameDef} ate on a rock above the beach, keeping an eye on {X_indefinite} nosing through the drift.
[land:mountains|land:hills] Somewhere up the valley {X_indefinite} called, and the mountains threw the call back three times. {A_nameDef} lay awake and couldn't tell which of the calls was real.
[land:desert] Out on the cold sand {X_indefinite} called once, long and thin, and the silence afterward was the biggest {A_nameDef} has ever heard.
[land:tundra|land:boreal] The calls came across the snow from the dark trees, carrying for miles in the still cold. {A_nameDef} checked the gate and then checked it again.

[land:coast] On {A_possessive} midnight walk along the shore, {A_nameDef} met {X_indefinite} at the waterline, black against the moonlit surf. They stood a while and listened to the sea, then went separate ways.
[land:river] {A_nameDef} sat by the river in the dark, and {X_indefinite} came down to drink a few paces upstream as if {A_nameDef} were part of the bank.
[land:desert] Wherever {A_nameDef} works, {X_definite} finds the nearest patch of shade and lies in it, moving round the post with the sun as the day goes on.
[land:swamp|land:jungle] Out on the wet ground again, {X_definite} followed {A_nameDef} everywhere and came back so muddy that only {X_possessive} eyes were the right color.
[land:coast] {A_nameDef} spent the day mending nets with {X_definite} lying across {A_possessive} feet, watching the gulls with deep suspicion.
[land:desert] {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} which wells along the caravan road have gone dry since spring, and which oasis now charges for water. Both lists are longer than last year.
[land:mountains|land:hills] A rockfall on the north road, and a new toll at the top of the pass. {A_nameDef} asked {X_nameDef} who was charging it, and didn't like the name.
[land:coast] According to {X_nameDef}, a ship broke up on the reef two bays down, and the whole coast has been walking the tide line for what washed ashore.

[land:tundra|land:boreal] The winter road over the frozen lake opened early this year, {X_nameDef} said, and three caravans have already crossed. One went through the ice, and {A_nameDef} heard every detail of how they got out.
[land:desert] {X_nameDef} has crossed this desert eleven times and told {A_nameDef} about the worst of them, the week-long sandstorm and the night the camels ran.
[land:jungle|land:swamp] {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} about the river towns downstream, built on stilts over the water, where children learn to swim before they walk.
